method.profile: Independent five-column median RGB strips; per-image linear background from remote sidebands; no source-selected masks or renderer splines.
method.peak: Contiguous fractions of positive mean-RGB background residual around independently selected peak; encoded-sRGB diagnostic intensity, apparent screen profile, not physical tube radius.
method.envelope: Bounding support of max absolute per-channel residual at fixed 3/5/10 digital levels; exploratory visibility envelopes, not certified bloom layers.
method.sectionSelection: Two fixed interior raster x coordinates on the visually isolated horizontal left feed. Equivalent section orientation, independently evaluated y peak. Original route ROI remains unchanged.
method.units: 8-bit sRGB residual digital levels; CSS spans divide raster spans by accepted screenshot DPR 2.

bands.interpretation: Independent hue support outside the strict core; background/pulse/contact overlap can make it ambiguous. Neither quantity is world-space radius.
